title: Lost or stolen debit card
text: If your debit card is lost or stolen, lock it right away in the mobile app under Cards > Lock card, then call 1-800-555-0100 to report it. We cancel the old card and mail a replacement within 5 to 7 business days. You are not responsible for unauthorized purchases reported within 2 business days.

title: Replacement card fee
text: Standard replacement cards are free. Expedited delivery in 1 to 2 business days costs $15 and can be requested from the app or by phone.

title: Domestic wire transfers
text: Domestic wires sent before 4 p.m. ET on a business day usually arrive the same day. The fee is $25 per outgoing domestic wire. Incoming wires are free.

title: International wire transfers
text: International wires take 1 to 5 business days depending on the destination country and intermediary banks. The fee is $45 per outgoing international wire, and the receiving bank may charge its own fee.

title: Zelle sending limits
text: You can send up to $2,500 per day and $10,000 per month with Zelle. Limits may be lower for new accounts during the first 30 days.

title: Overdraft fees
text: We charge a $35 overdraft fee when a transaction overdraws your account by more than $50. There is no fee if you bring the balance back to zero by the end of the next business day. We charge at most 3 overdraft fees per day.

title: Overdraft protection
text: Overdraft protection links your checking account to a savings account. If checking runs short, we move the missing amount from savings for free instead of charging an overdraft fee.

title: Setting up direct deposit
text: To set up direct deposit, give your employer your routing number and account number, which you can find in the app under Account details. Your first direct deposit usually arrives within 1 to 2 pay cycles.

title: Early direct deposit
text: With early pay, eligible direct deposits can arrive up to 2 days before your scheduled payday. Timing depends on when your employer sends the payment.

title: Finding your routing number
text: Our ABA routing number for checking and savings accounts is 021000021. For incoming wires, use the wire routing number shown in the app under Account details.

title: Savings interest rate
text: High-yield savings currently earns 4.10% APY on all balances. The rate is variable and may change after the account is opened. Interest compounds daily and is paid monthly.

title: Savings withdrawals
text: You can make unlimited transfers out of savings in the app. Transfers to an external bank take 1 to 3 business days.

title: CD early withdrawal penalty
text: Withdrawing from a certificate of deposit before it matures costs 90 days of interest for terms of 12 months or less, and 180 days of interest for longer terms.

title: Minimum balance and monthly fee
text: Everyday Checking has a $12 monthly service fee. The fee is waived if you keep a $1,500 minimum daily balance or receive $500 or more in direct deposits each month.

title: Closing an account
text: To close an account, transfer out the remaining balance and call us or visit a branch. Accounts with a zero balance can also be closed in the app under Settings > Close account. There is no fee to close an account.

title: Disputing a card charge
text: To dispute a charge, open the transaction in the app and tap Report a problem. We may give you a temporary credit while we investigate. Most disputes are resolved within 10 business days, and some can take up to 90 days.

title: Suspicious activity alerts
text: If we notice unusual activity we send a text asking you to confirm the purchase. Reply YES if it was you or NO if it was not. We will never ask for your PIN, password or full card number by text or phone.

title: Phishing and scam messages
text: We never ask for your password, one-time code or PIN. If you get a message that asks for them, do not reply. Forward the message to phishing@examplebank.com and delete it.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Two-factor authentication adds a one-time code when you sign in from a new device. Turn it on in Settings > Security. You can receive codes by text or through an authenticator app.

title: Resetting your password
text: To reset your password, tap Forgot password on the sign-in screen and follow the link we email you. The link expires after 30 minutes.

title: Locked out of online banking
text: After 5 failed sign-in attempts your online banking access is locked for 30 minutes. If you are still locked out after that, reset your password or call support.

title: Mobile check deposit
text: Deposit checks in the app by taking photos of the front and back. Sign the back and write For mobile deposit only. The daily mobile deposit limit is $5,000, and funds are usually available the next business day.

title: Check holds
text: Some deposited checks are placed on hold. The first $225 is available the next business day, and the rest is usually available within 2 business days. Large or unusual checks may be held up to 7 business days.

title: ATM fees
text: Withdrawals at our ATMs are free. We charge $3 for out-of-network ATM withdrawals in the US, and the ATM owner may add its own fee.

title: ATM withdrawal limit
text: The default daily ATM withdrawal limit is $800. You can request a temporary increase in the app for up to 3 days.

title: Foreign transaction fees
text: Debit card purchases made in a foreign currency have a 3% foreign transaction fee. Our travel credit card has no foreign transaction fees.

title: Travel notices
text: You no longer need to set a travel notice. Our fraud system recognizes travel automatically, but keep your phone number up to date so we can reach you if a purchase looks unusual.

title: Free credit score
text: Customers can see a free VantageScore 3.0 credit score in the app. Checking it does not affect your credit.

title: Adding a joint owner
text: To add a joint owner to a checking or savings account, both people must visit a branch with a government-issued photo ID. Joint owners have equal access to the full balance.

title: Account statements
text: Monthly statements are available in the app under Documents for the last 7 years. Paper statements cost $2 per month unless you are 65 or older.
